title: Build candidate intake and profile

passes.outcome: implemented without a separate plan comment (single Standards smell)

blocker: Family-work classification in packages/profile/src/experience-type.ts is the same blocking condition across four consecutive passes (2-5). Each repair fixed one phrasing and exposed another: pass 2 over-classified "un puesto en la empresa ... mi familia" as family_business; pass 3 under-classified "puesto de mi mama" and "comercio familiar"; pass 4 over-matched "comercio de mi ciudad"; pass 5 under-classifies the plural "puesto de mis padres" (now formal_employment via the 'puesto de' keyword). The deterministic keyword heuristic has reached its limit on this ambiguous vocabulary ('puesto' = job vs market stall). A product decision is required: either accept and document the heuristic's known edges, or replace family-work detection with a model-assisted classifier (which belongs to the agent/safety plane, #9).

deferred.finding: PII vault pseudonymization (parent-spec risk, not a ticket #4 acceptance criterion)
Retain the original input for correction (parent-spec risk)

accepted.finding: Optional LLM provider adapter (openrouter.ts, llm-extractor.ts, pii.ts)
accepted.reason: Optional, thin, re-validated downstream, deterministic fallback intact; in-scope for the agent that consumes #4's contracts

resolved: Declared-only level cap is enforced against the intake provenance and the evidence source is clamped (spec #4)
Resilient extractor reports the strategy per call instead of via shared mutable state
Academic work and family work are extracted (academic reachable; family work by venue + relation)
Standards smells from passes 1-4 repaired (dead exports, duplicated helpers, magic numbers, dead import, Middle Man, data clumps, single-sourced family venues)
handoff: Do not start ship-subissue: the loop is blocked, not clean. ship-subissue may proceed only after the family-work blocker is resolved or explicitly accepted by a human.
riskRemaining: The deterministic heuristic remains imprecise for ambiguous Spanish work vocabulary (puesto, comercio, local). Section headers can still surface as experiences or certifications, and sentence titles can be truncated. These are deterministic-path quality limits, not contract failures; every emitted fact is anchored to an exact statement and the profile is schema-valid.
